$comment: Visual-fidelity acceptance config — copy to quality/visual-parity.config.json in the target project and edit. Consumed by scripts/check-visual-fidelity.mjs (reference: scripts/check-visual-fidelity.reference.mjs). referenceUrl is the ground-truth page (the live site being replicated); localUrl is the build under test. The check captures both at every breakpoint, hard-fails when page-height delta exceeds maxHeightDeltaPct (structural mismatch — pixel diffing is pointless), then runs a masked pixel diff that must score >= threshold on EVERY breakpoint. Masks and dynamicRegions hide regions that legitimately differ (cookie banners, carousels, timestamps); every applied mask is recorded in docs/qa/visual-diff/<breakpoint>/report.json so masking stays auditable, never silent.
